fields.h1: Build an Employee Termination Form Template With HR Review
fields.hero_description: Build an employee termination form template that holds each request for HR review and keeps the record in your database.
fields.features_heading: Everything HR Needs Before the Last Day
fields.features_subheading: A paper template ends at a signature line. Built with Emergent, the form carries each separation from request to final pay.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that follow the separation type

Pick resignation, involuntary termination, or layoff at the top of the form. It then asks what that type needs, such as a notice date for a resignation or prior write-ups.
fields.feature_2:
HR review before anyone is told

A manager's request stays pending until HR approves it. Nothing goes to payroll while it is open, and HR's decision is saved on the record with the reviewer's name and the date.
fields.feature_3:
Alerts that carry a link, not the details

Send HR an email or Slack alert that says a form is in, with a link to it. The employee's name, the reason, and the pay details stay inside the app, behind that link.
fields.feature_4:
A reason written as dated facts

Ask for the reason as dated events, and attach prior write-ups or coaching notes from the same database. Have HR or counsel review the wording before the record is final.
fields.feature_5:
The employee's signature and comments

Capture the employee's e-signature to confirm they received the separation notice, next to a box for their own comments. Have counsel decide what that signature covers.
fields.feature_6:
Code that moves to your own GitHub

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository and run the form inside the HR system you already use. Every separation record stays in a database you own.

fields.usecase_heading: How Four Employers Handle a Separation
fields.tab_content_1:
No one tells the employee until HR approves

Kitchen manager Wenzeslaus Vorhaut at Corbelline Bistro Group files a termination request for employee E-2087 with 2 prior write-ups attached. HR director Severine Pelletreau gets an email that a termination request is in, with a link. Until she approves, the request stays pending and nothing reaches the employee.
fields.tab_content_2:
Zuzana's notice goes in with a last day 14 days out

Zuzana Alcazaba hands in her notice as a hygienist at Mirabeck Dental. The office manager logs the notice date, a last day 14 days later, and the reason in Zuzana's words: a move to Tucson. Eligible for rehire is marked Yes. Zuzana signs on the front desk tablet to confirm her last day.
fields.tab_content_3:
Payroll gets it all by link: the last day and 36 PTO hours

Approval at Haverwick Freight sends payroll one email saying a separation is ready for final pay, with a link. The email holds no name or amount. Behind the link, the record shows the last day, 36 unused PTO hours, and whether the employee returned the company phone. The payroll lead sets the final pay date from there.
fields.tab_content_4:
Rosmunda sees which of 23 separations were involuntary

Rosmunda Brascombe opens the separation log at Cobbleridge Home Care. This year it holds 23 records: 12 resignations, 7 involuntary terminations and 4 layoffs. Each record carries a keep-until date that HR set with counsel. Before a records review, she filters the log down to the 7 involuntary terminations.

fields.howto_title: How to Create an Employee Termination Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create an employee termination form template that takes each separation through HR review and into one record.
fields.howto_step_1_des: List the separations you handle, such as resignations, involuntary terminations, layoffs, and retirements. Each one becomes a path on the form with its own questions. A resignation asks for the notice date, while a termination asks for prior write-ups.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write the reason for someone who opens the record a year from now: what happened, on which dates, and which policy it relates to. Keep opinions about the person off the form, and let counsel check the final text.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Choose who approves each type before anything moves. A manager's termination request might wait for the HR director, while a resignation goes to the office manager. Nothing reaches payroll or the employee until the approver decides.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Give payroll the fields it needs on one record: the last day, unused PTO hours, and any equipment still out. Have HR or counsel confirm the final pay deadline for each state where you employ people.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Add an e-signature step where the employee confirms they received the separation notice, with a box for their comments. Have counsel decide what the signature confirms. Record a refusal to sign as its own answer instead of a blank.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Ask the approver whether the person is eligible for rehire, with a short note on why. The answer saves to the database, where a recruiter can find it months later when a former employee applies again.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Run 3 past separations through the form before you use it, one of each type. Check that each reached the right approver, that payroll's email held no names, and that the record showed every field HR needed.

faq_plan.q: What is an employee termination form template?
faq_plan.a: An employee termination form template is the standard form HR completes when someone leaves the company. It records the separation type, the last day, the reason, final pay details, and the signatures. Using one template puts every separation record in the same shape for whoever reads it later.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an employee termination form template?
faq_plan.a: Describe your separation types and approvers to Emergent's AI form builder, and it builds the form and the database behind it, with the review step included. Start with the 2 or 3 separation types you handle most, then change the form by prompting as you test it.

faq_plan.q: How many sections should an employee termination form template have?
faq_plan.a: Five sections cover it: the employee and role, the separation type and last day, the reason, the final pay hand-off, and the acknowledgment. Put the approver's decision at the end of the reason section. Ask HR or counsel to sign off on the field list before the first use.

faq_plan.q: Can an employee termination form template update the original hire record?
faq_plan.a: Yes, when both forms write to the same employee table. If your new employee form saves each hire to that table, the termination form can close the same row with the last day and separation type. With Emergent, that table sits in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: What final pay details belong on an employee termination form template?
faq_plan.a: Record the last day worked, unused PTO hours, any company equipment still out, and the pay date payroll sets. The U.S. Department of Labor says employers are not required by federal law to give former employees their final paycheck immediately. It adds that some states may require immediate payment. Check each state's deadline with HR or counsel.

faq_plan.q: How do I add a keep-until date to an employee termination form template?
faq_plan.a: Add a date field that HR fills in when it approves the separation, and show it in the separation log. EEOC guidance says that if an employee is involuntarily terminated, their personnel records must be retained for one year. Ask counsel which dates to use.

faq_plan.q: How do I link earlier write-ups to an employee termination form template?
faq_plan.a: Save write-ups in the same database, then let the manager pick them from a list on the termination request. An employee write up form template that stores each write-up with the employee's signature gives the reviewer every earlier step in one view.

faq_plan.q: Can employees e-sign an employee termination form template?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Apps built with Emergent can capture an e-signature, and the employee signs on a phone or computer from a link HR sends after the meeting. Put a comments box beside the signature. Counsel can tell you what the signature should confirm.

faq_plan.q: Who approves the requests an employee termination form template collects?
faq_plan.a: Have HR approve every involuntary termination request before the employee hears about it, and add counsel for the cases HR flags. A resignation can go to the employee's manager alone. Set the approver per separation type, and keep payroll out until the approval lands.

faq_plan.q: How can an employee termination form template show completed training?
faq_plan.a: Pull it from the same database. When an employee training form records each course and the date it was completed, the termination request can list those courses. The reviewer then sees whether the person was trained on the policy the reason cites.
